scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec -w /app api npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.docker:generate: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec -w /app api npx prisma generate
scripts.docker:studio: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec -w /app api npx prisma studio
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.yml exec -w /app api npx prisma migrate reset --force
